description.raw: '''Active:''' '''LeBlanc''' [[File:Dash.png|20px|link=Dash|An icon representing the keyword Dash]] [[:Dash|dashes]] to the target location, dealing magic damage to all nearby enemies upon arrival and leaving a return pad at the cast location for 4 seconds. ''Distortion'' can be recast after 0.2 seconds of the dash ending for the pad's duration.
description.text: Active: LeBlanc dashes to the target location, dealing magic damage to all nearby enemies upon arrival and leaving a return pad at the cast location for 4 seconds. Distortion can be recast after 0.2 seconds of the dash ending for the pad's duration.

description2.raw: '''Recast:''' '''LeBlanc''' [[File:Flash.png|20px|link=Blink|An icon representing the keyword Blink]] [[:Blink|blinks]] to ''Distortion's'' return pad, regardless of range.
description2.text: Recast: LeBlanc blinks to Distortion's return pad, regardless of range.

leveling.raw:
'''Magic Damage:'''
75 / 115 / 155 / 195 / 235 (+ 90% AP)

notes.raw: * ''Distortion'' has no minimum dash range. * ''Distortion'' will be buffered and cast as soon as the cooldown ends if the player attempts to cast it within 0.5 seconds of the cooldown ending. ** The '''recast''' will be buffered and cast as soon as it becomes available if the player attempts to cast it within 0.3 seconds of it becoming available to cast. *The initial cast counts as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as [[File:Sheen item.png|20px|link=Named item effect#Spellblade|An icon representing the keyword Spellblade]] [[:Named item effect#Spellblade|Spellblade]] and triggering [[File:Kassadin Force Pulse.png|20xpx|border|link=Kassadin#Force Pulse|An icon for Kassadin's ability Force Pulse]] [[Kassadin#Force Pulse|Force Pulse's]] passive. **Recasting the ability does not. **[[File:LeBlanc Mimic- Distortion.png|20xpx|border|link=LeBlanc#Mimic: Distortion|An icon for LeBlanc's ability Mimic: Distortion]] [[LeBlanc#Mimic: Distortion|Mimic: Distortion]] has the same properties. * ''Distortion'' and [[File:LeBlanc Mimic- Distortion.png|20xpx|border|link=LeBlanc#Mimic: Distortion|An icon for LeBlanc's ability Mimic: Distortion]] [[LeBlanc#Mimic: Distortion|Mimic: Distortion]] have independent return pads and '''LeBlanc''' can travel to both while they are active. * ''Distortion's'' pad duration starts once the dash ends.
notes.text:
Distortion has no minimum dash range.
Distortion will be buffered and cast as soon as the cooldown ends if the player attempts to cast it within 0.5 seconds of the cooldown ending.
* The recast will be buffered and cast as soon as it becomes available if the player attempts to cast it within 0.3 seconds of it becoming available to cast.
The initial cast counts as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as Spellblade and triggering Force Pulse's passive.
*Recasting the ability does not.
* Mimic: Distortion has the same properties.
Distortion and Mimic: Distortion have independent return pads and LeBlanc can travel to both while they are active.
Distortion's pad duration starts once the dash ends.
